subject: Unwinding close drift — tiered remediation & MAP recovery
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Pratt <samantha.pratt@novora.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Unwinding close drift — tiered remediation & MAP recovery

Samantha —

Thanks again for the candid update this morning. From our side we ran a quick impact triage and sketched a short, tiered MAP you can share with your stakeholders. The goal is to keep your go-live window intact while isolating the root causes that drove the evaluation slip (incomplete KV-cache sizing on the PoC and an unexpected token-cost spike on longer summaries).

Attached is a 2-page MAP draft that:
- Defines 3 remediation tiers (hotfix, near-term config, hold-and-validate)
- Calls out who owns each checkpoint and expected artifact (logs, sample outputs, perf trace)
- Includes a conservative timeline for each lane and a rollback trigger set

Immediate asks for Novora:
1) Share the eval-team's latest perf trace (the small sample you mentioned) — we can ingest it and produce a KV sizing recommendation within 24h.
2) Confirm which services are in scope for the July 31 close (full-prod vs pilot-only).
3) Approve a short canary window where we run the heavier prompts at reduced concurrency.

I've attached the draft MAP and a redacted sample/attachments index for your security team. If the team is available Monday, Marcus and I can join a 30-min working session to finalize roles and commit windows.

Thanks,
Diego
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: 20250719_MAP-tiered-remediation-v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); novora-eval-logs-sample.zip (zip, redacted logs, 12 MB)

From: Samantha Pratt <samantha.pratt@novora.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novora Technical Evaluation Team <eval-team@novora.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unwinding close drift — tiered remediation & MAP recovery

Diego —

Appreciate the quick turn. High level response from the eval group after reviewing your MAP: the classification into hotfix/near-term/hold looks sensible. A few clarifications and constraints from our side:

- The perf trace we described is attached (redacted), but it only covers the longer summarization prompts. We cannot yet share full production traces due to PHI gating; we'll work with you on a redaction pattern.
- For scope: we currently expect the close to include pilot-only (Phase 1) for July 31, with full-prod targeted for Aug 28 depending on the results of your remediation lanes.
- Our procurement team will need visibility on any SLA/credits if the Phase 1 timeline slips beyond July 31.

Two immediate asks:
1) Can you provide a prioritized checklist for what would be considered a Phase 1 'accept' vs 'defer' decision? (i.e., must-have vs nice-to-have features at go-live)
2) Who will be the escalation owner at Redwood should the near-term fix not clear validation by July 28? We need a single point of contact for the procurement/escalation thread.

We'll stand up a Monday 11:00am PST call with the eval team to talk through the MAP and the sample.

Thanks,
Samantha Pratt
Director of Product Ops, Novora Therapeutics
---
Attachments: novora-eval-trace-redacted.json (redacted perf trace)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Unwinding close drift — tiered remediation & MAP recovery

Folks — forwarding Novora's response and the redacted trace. Rapid notes and recommended posture:

1) Triage lane assignments (short):
   - Hotfix (P0): Marcus (runtime config change - reduce KV window, limit concurrent long-summary tokens) — target validation by 24h after receiving full redacted trace.
   - Near-term (P1): Grace (quantization / batching profile changes for pilot) — target validation by July 28.
   - Hold & Validate (P2): Diego (contract/SLA gating and paperwork; procurement touch points) — contingency plan if Phase 1 acceptance fails.

2) Escalation owner: I will serve as interim escalation owner for contract/credits while Diego coordinates procurement. If P1 fails to validate by July 28, we will trigger a pre-agreed credit conversation and schedule an exec-to-exec sync.

3) Deliverable checklist (quick):
   - Phase 1 accept: successful canary within pilot concurrency; no more than 2% regression in latency p95; documented sample outputs that meet Novora QA pass criteria.
   - Phase 1 defer: if canary fails, we move to an extended pilot (2 weeks) with reduced concurrency and conditional credit.

I'll join the Monday 11am call. Marcus, Grace — can you prepare a 10-min runbook for your lanes? Diego — can you draft the procurement escalation stub we can share with Novora's procurement during the call?

Laura
VP Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: internal-triage-lanes.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Pratt <samantha.pratt@novora.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unwinding close drift — tiered remediation & MAP recovery

Samantha —

Thanks for the call and for sharing the redacted traces. Quick summary of what we agreed on and next steps (confirmed on the call):

Agreed checkpoints and timeline:
- July 22 (today): Redwood provides KV sizing recommendation and a short hotfix patch (Marcus) — attached.
- July 24: Canary run window for Phase 1 (reduced concurrency); Novora provides QA pass/fail.
- July 28: Deadline for Near-term validation (Grace) — if pass, proceed with July 31 pilot close for Phase 1.
- July 31: Planned Phase 1 close (pilot).
- Aug 14: Post-pilot review and backlog for Phase 2 full-prod target Aug 28.

Escalation & procurement:
- Laura is interim escalation owner for contract/credits. I will run the procurement thread (deal notes, DocuSign link) and keep Novora's procurement in the loop. If Phase 1 cannot be accepted by July 28, we will open the credit conversation and schedule an exec sync for escalation.

Deliverables sent: 20250722_kv-sizing-recommendation.txt; updated MAP v1.1 (attached). Please confirm receipt and whether Novora wants an expedited follow-up with our SREs during the July 24 canary.

Diego
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
